about: Evani.Dev looks (art styles). cost_points is the look's share of each tier budget.

looks.name: 1-bit monochrome
looks.look: Two colours only, dithered shading, crisp silhouettes.
looks.render_rules: Render to a low internal resolution (about 400×240), threshold everything to two palette colours, Bayer dithering for midtones, integer upscale.

looks.name: Handheld 4-shade
looks.look: Four shades of green-grey on a tiny 160×144 screen.
looks.render_rules: 160×144 internal target, 4-colour palette lookup, 8×8 tile maps, nearest-neighbour integer upscale with letterboxing.

looks.name: 8-bit pixel
looks.look: Chunky sprites, a small fixed palette, tile-based worlds.
looks.render_rules: 256×240 internal, fixed 54-colour palette, 8×8 tiles, 3 colours plus transparent per sprite, no sub-pixel positions.

looks.name: 16-bit pixel
looks.look: Richer palettes, layered parallax, detailed sprite animation.
looks.render_rules: 320×224 internal, up to 256 colours with per-layer palettes, 16×16 tiles, several parallax planes, palette cycling for water and fire.

looks.name: HD pixel art
looks.look: Modern pixel art with a smooth camera, dynamic light and lots of particles.
looks.render_rules: 480×270 internal, pixel-perfect sprites with sub-pixel camera smoothing, optional normal-mapped 2D lights, particles at native resolution.

looks.name: Isometric pixel
looks.look: Diamond tile grids with clean 2:1 pixel lines, crafted little dioramas.
looks.render_rules: 2:1 isometric projection, 32×16 tile footprint, depth sort by (x + y, z), static tile chunks cached to textures.

looks.name: ASCII text-mode
looks.look: Glyph grids, colour-coded characters, terminal feel.
looks.render_rules: Monospace glyph atlas, fixed character grid (about 80×45), per-cell foreground and background colour; all drawing is cell writes into one instanced pass.

looks.name: Glowing vector lines
looks.look: Thin bright lines on black, like an old vector arcade monitor.
looks.render_rules: Everything drawn as line lists with additive blending, phosphor persistence from a frame-feedback texture, light bloom.

looks.name: Flat geometric
looks.look: Clean shapes, solid fills, strong colour blocking, no texture.
looks.render_rules: Shapes as SDFs or tessellated polygons, a 5 to 7 colour palette, soft drop shadows only.

looks.name: Neon synthwave 2D
looks.look: Magenta and cyan neon, gradient sunsets, perspective grid floors.
looks.render_rules: Additive neon strokes with glow, gradient sky layers, scrolling perspective grid; pairs well with bloom.

looks.name: Cartoon 2D
looks.look: Bold outlines, flat cel colours, squash-and-stretch animation.
looks.render_rules: Vector-style sprites with 3 to 4 px dark outlines, two-tone cel shading baked into sprites, squash and stretch in the animator.

looks.name: Anime 2D
looks.look: Clean line art, cel shading, expressive portraits and impact effects.
looks.render_rules: High-resolution sprites with thin line art and two-tone shading, impact frames and speed-line overlays, portrait layers for dialogue.

looks.name: 1930s rubber-hose cartoon
looks.look: Pie-cut eyes, bendy limbs, sepia film, hand-inked backgrounds.
looks.render_rules: Boiling-line animation (2 to 3 frame line jitter), sepia grade, film grain, gate weave and vignette.

looks.name: Hand-drawn sketch
looks.look: Pencil or notebook doodles on paper.
looks.render_rules: Paper texture background, wobbly lines regenerated every few frames, cross-hatch shading.

looks.name: Watercolour 2D
looks.look: Soft washes, bleeding edges, visible paper grain.
looks.render_rules: Painted layers with darkened edges, paper normal texture, a gentle colour-bleed shader on edges.

looks.name: Ink brush
looks.look: Black ink strokes, splashes, negative space, one accent colour.
looks.render_rules: Brush-stroke sprites, ink-splat particles, rice-paper background, a single accent colour.

looks.name: Comic book
looks.look: Heavy inks, halftone dots, panel framing, sound words.
looks.render_rules: Halftone shading shader, thick outlines, comic-panel transitions, pop-up sound-word sprites.

looks.name: Paper cutout
looks.look: Layered paper shapes with drop shadows and torn edges.
looks.render_rules: Layered sprites with offset soft shadows, slight rotation wobble, paper fibre texture.

looks.name: Silhouette
looks.look: Black foreground shapes against atmospheric gradients.
looks.render_rules: Foreground fully black, background gradient layers with fog, light shafts, rim light on characters.

looks.name: Flash-era vector
looks.look: Smooth vector characters with cut-out skeletal animation.
looks.render_rules: Bone-rigged cut-out parts with mesh deformation, tweened animation curves, crisp vector edges at any resolution.

looks.name: Pre-rendered isometric
looks.look: Late-90s look: 3D models rendered into sprites with 8 or 16 facings.
looks.render_rules: Sprite sheets with 8 or 16 facings per animation, pre-lit, team-colour palette masks, isometric depth sort.

looks.name: Tabletop materials
looks.look: Wood, felt, cardboard tokens and printed cards.
looks.render_rules: Textured board and token sprites, soft contact shadows, card flip and slide tweens.

looks.name: Mode-7 floor plane
looks.look: A rotating, scaling textured ground plane with sprite racers, 16-bit style.
looks.render_rules: Per-scanline affine transform of a ground texture into a perspective floor, horizon sky layer, billboard sprites with 8 to 12 facing angles.

looks.name: Sprite-scaling road
looks.look: Curving, rolling road segments with scaled roadside sprites, arcade-cabinet style.
looks.render_rules: Segment-projected road with curve and hill offsets per segment, alternating stripe colours, scaled billboard sprites, parallax sky.

looks.name: Raycast 2.5D
looks.look: Grid maps with textured walls and sprite enemies, early-90s shooter style.
looks.render_rules: DDA raycast per screen column, textured walls and floors, per-column depth for sprite occlusion, distance shading.

looks.name: HD-2D diorama
looks.look: Pixel sprites inside a lit 3D diorama with depth of field and bloom.
looks.render_rules: 3D scene with pixel-art textures and nearest filtering; characters are pixel sprites drawn as camera-facing billboards; tilt-shift depth of field, bloom and point lights carry the look.

looks.name: 2.5D side view
looks.look: 3D models on a 2D gameplay plane, with depth in the backgrounds.
looks.render_rules: Gameplay locked to the z = 0 plane with 2D physics; 3D models and a perspective camera; foreground and background built as 3D layers.

looks.name: Low-poly flat-shaded
looks.look: Faceted geometry, flat colours, gradient skies.
looks.render_rules: Per-face normals, vertex colours or one palette texture, no texture maps, hemisphere ambient plus one directional light.

looks.name: Retro 32-bit
looks.look: Wobbly vertices, warped textures, crunchy low resolution.
looks.render_rules: 320×240 internal, vertex snapping to a coarse grid, affine (non-perspective) texture mapping, nearest filtering, 15-bit colour with dithering.

looks.name: Retro 64-bit
looks.look: Soft blurry textures, heavy fog, chunky smooth-shaded models.
looks.render_rules: Small 32 to 64 px textures with 3-point filtering, Gouraud vertex lighting, strong distance fog, 320×240 internal.

looks.name: Voxel
looks.look: Worlds and characters built from cubes.
looks.render_rules: Greedy-meshed chunks (16³ or 32³), per-vertex ambient occlusion, palette texture, chunk frustum and occlusion culling.

looks.name: Toy brick
looks.look: Glossy studded plastic bricks and blocky toy figures; worlds look snap-built.
looks.render_rules: Instanced brick meshes with studs (studs drop at distance), glossy plastic material with low roughness, bevel highlights; all designs original.

looks.name: Claymation
looks.look: Soft clay surfaces, fingerprints, stop-motion stepping.
looks.render_rules: Wrap lighting for a soft subsurface feel, fingerprint normal noise, animation sampled at 12 fps for a stop-motion feel.

looks.name: Felt and wood toys
looks.look: Handmade craft materials: felt, yarn and wood grain.
looks.render_rules: Fresnel fuzz for felt, triplanar wood-grain textures, soft shadows, warm key light.

looks.name: Papercraft 3D
looks.look: Folded paper models with creases and card thickness.
looks.render_rules: Planar folded meshes with crease lines, paper fibre texture, plain backfaces, soft ambient occlusion.

looks.name: Toon cel-shaded
looks.look: Hard-edged lighting bands and ink outlines, like an animated film.
looks.render_rules: 2 to 3 band ramp diffuse, specular blob, inverted-hull or post-process outlines, saturated palette.

looks.name: Chibi
looks.look: Big heads, tiny bodies, cute and bouncy.
looks.render_rules: Head-to-body ratio of 1:1.5 to 1:2, soft toon shading, rim light, bouncy procedural secondary motion.

looks.name: Pastel cozy
looks.look: Soft pastels, rounded forms, gentle light.
looks.render_rules: Rounded bevelled meshes, pastel palette, soft wrap lighting, light fog, no harsh blacks.

looks.name: Hand-painted stylized
looks.look: Painted textures with baked light and exaggerated shapes.
looks.render_rules: Painted albedo with baked lighting, mostly unlit shading, exaggerated silhouettes, 512 to 1024 px textures.

looks.name: Stylized PBR
looks.look: Vibrant colours, chunky proportions, clean physically based materials.
looks.render_rules: Metal-roughness PBR with simplified textures, saturated albedo, strong rim and ambient occlusion, image-based light from a small cubemap.

looks.name: Realistic PBR
looks.look: Physically based materials, natural light, believable scale.
looks.render_rules: Metal-roughness PBR, image-based lighting (prefiltered cubemap plus BRDF lookup), ACES tonemapping, cascaded shadows, KTX2 texture streaming.

looks.name: Gritty photoreal
looks.look: Desaturated documentary realism, grime and wear.
looks.render_rules: Full PBR with detail maps, grime decals, photographic colour grade, volumetric atmosphere, high-resolution KTX2 textures streamed by distance.

looks.name: Diorama tilt-shift
looks.look: The world looks like a tabletop miniature.
looks.render_rules: High camera angle, strong tilt-shift blur band, slightly oversaturated materials, soft contact shadows.

looks.name: Untextured minimal
looks.look: Solid colours and light only; geometric and clean.
looks.render_rules: Single-colour materials, one or two lights, crisp shadows when budget allows, one signal colour for anything interactive.

looks.name: Wireframe hologram
looks.look: Glowing edges, scanline shimmer, sci-fi HUD.
looks.render_rules: Barycentric wireframe shader, additive glow, scanline and flicker noise, depth-faded edges.

looks.name: Synthwave 3D
looks.look: Neon grid landscapes, chrome, striped sunsets.
looks.render_rules: Emissive grid terrain, chrome through environment-map reflection, gradient sky with a striped sun, bloom required.

looks.name: Dark fantasy painterly
looks.look: Muted palettes, gothic shapes, heavy atmosphere.
looks.render_rules: PBR or painted albedo, low-key lighting, fog volumes, warm torch point lights, desaturated grade.

looks.name: Noir monochrome
looks.look: Black and white, hard shadows, one accent colour.
looks.render_rules: Greyscale grade with an optional single accent hue, hard shadows, high-contrast key light, film grain.

looks.name: VHS horror
looks.look: Low resolution, tape distortion, oppressive darkness.
looks.render_rules: 480×270 internal, tape-wobble and chroma-bleed post, heavy grain, a flashlight as the main light.

looks.name: Watercolour 3D
looks.look: 3D scenes shaded like a painting, with pigment bleed and paper.
looks.render_rules: Watercolour post shader (Kuwahara-style smoothing), edge darkening, paper texture overlay, wobbling ink edges.

looks.name: Ink hatching 3D
looks.look: Pen-and-ink illustration with hatched shading.
looks.render_rules: Tonal art maps (hatching textures blended by light intensity), screen-space outlines, off-white paper background.
